name: resolution
purpose: Compose a cited resolution suggestion from retrieved historical cases.

note: No temperature/top_p/top_k: these are removed on Claude Opus 5 and return a 400.
Thinking is on by default on Opus 5, and max_output_tokens caps thinking AND
response text together. 8000 leaves room for both; a tight budget truncates
the JSON mid-object and forces the deterministic fallback for no reason.

invariants: No confidence, probability, score, or percentage field is requested or accepted.
Evidence is fenced and explicitly labeled untrusted data.
Every step must cite at least one evidence ticket id.
Abstention via insufficient_evidence is an explicitly valued outcome.

changelog.note: Initial version. Any wording change that could alter output requires a new version directory, not an edit here.
